_about: Batch 2 of the user's CSV of regional tech companies, researched from public sources 2026-10-03. Same rules as real-companies.json: every row carries the sources it was taken from; nothing is inferred or invented; a field that could not be sourced is null. CSV notes were treated as leads only. Headcount and founded never come from aggregators. Coordinates come from the Mapbox Geocoding API applied to the sourced street address; rows without a sourced street address have null coordinates and a district taken from the sourced city.
